verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork has a first-party scheduled tasks feature. Users describe a task once, and it runs automatically on a recurring basis or on demand, delivering outputs such as reports and briefings. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. Missing for 10: details on schedule granularity and configuration (cron-like intervals, time zones), management of scheduled runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Scheduled tasks allow you to delegate work to Claude Cowork by creating tasks that run automatically on a recurring basis, or on demand.
Instead of starting each task from scratch, you describe it once and Claude handles it on your schedule—delivering finished outputs like reports, briefings, and summaries every time.
